comparison.objective: Screw a corkscrew into a cork and extract it while stabilizing a bottle; candidate slides a guide block onto a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests bimanual stabilization plus helical tool engagement and axial extraction. Candidate tests parallel end-face mating and straight seam-crossing transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires cork engagement/extraction, bottle remaining in its cradle, release, and clearance. Candidate requires complete transfer, continuous support, all balls retained, and no damage or contamination.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is generic; helical extraction does not test an uncaged bearing's support continuity.
